offering_description.value: Regulated natural gas utility and propane distributor serving homes and businesses in Virginia, West Virginia and North Carolina. It delivers gas through its own distribution pipelines and sells propane by delivery to customers without pipeline access.

primary_services.value: natural gas distribution; propane delivery; appliance installation and service

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential households heating with gas or propane; B2B: commercial businesses and industrial customers

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: natural gas delivered to customers, billed by volume used; product sales: propane sold by delivery to tank customers; service fees: appliance installation, repair and maintenance
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs gas distribution pipelines and propane tanks serving customers; distributor: takes in natural gas and propane from suppliers and delivers to end users

geography_served.value: US regional: Virginia, West Virginia and North Carolina

specialization.value: related lines: natural gas distribution and propane distribution, both serving residential and business energy customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: utility and propane service sold directly to residential and business customers; own locations: company offices and service centers in its operating territories

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state utility commission approval needed to operate gas distribution and set rates, plus pipeline safety rules

notes: Current scope of propane operations and recent asset sales or minority holdings are uncertain; description may not reflect the latest portfolio.
